name: Teen Volunteers (Rutherford County Library System)
org: Rutherford County Library System, Linebaugh and Smyrna libraries
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library for a school semester. Tasks include shelving, shelf reading and tidying items.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 18 can apply to volunteer at the Smyrna Public Library. Linebaugh Library in Murfreesboro also takes teen volunteers by semester. The page lists no age range for Linebaugh.
duration: One semester. The Smyrna fall season runs Aug 17 to Nov 21. The page does not state a year.
deadline_text: Linebaugh says Fall 2026 volunteer applications are open. Smyrna says its applications are open. No closing date is stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application for the branch you want. At Smyrna, teens should fill out the form themselves, not a parent. Smyrna questions go to smyrnays@rclstn.org. Linebaugh questions go to kturner@rclstn.org or tdavis@rclstn.org.
notes: Other library branches are not taking volunteers right now, per the page. Volunteers age 18 and up use a different form.
